channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Bahrain releases footage of damage caused by intercepted Iranian drones
item.description: Bahrain released video of damage in Manama after debris from intercepted Iranian drones fell in populated areas

item.title: Trump says US will ‘be taking’ Kharg Island in latest Iran war threat
item.description: Trump says US will be hitting Iran 'very hard' as two days of strikes threaten to derail ceasefire negotiations.

item.title: Iran shuts Hormuz strait: But wasn’t it already closed?
item.description: The strait is a crucial maritime route, through which 20 percent of global oil and natural gas is shipped in peacetime.

item.title: At least 22 killed as Pakistani military helicopter crashes in Kashmir
item.description: Officials launch inquiry after 'technical fault' causes an army Mi-17 to crash in Pakistan-administered Kashmir.

item.title: Video shows aftermath of Iranian attack in Bahrain
item.description: Iranian strikes on Bahrain left cars, homes and buildings damaged in Hamad Town and Manama.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes across Middle East for second day in a row
item.description: Iran says it responded to US strikes by targeting American assets in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain, which reported damage to its capital city overnight.

item.title: Vance says Israeli PM Netanyahu 'has got some things wrong'
item.description: The US vice-president says the Israeli leader "aggressively asserts" his country's interests, but they do not always align with those of the US.

item.title: Four days of extreme rain killed 7% of world's rarest orangutans, study says
item.description: Climate change-induced weather events are pushing orangutan populations to extinction, says a study.

item.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 17, reports say
item.description: Nine of them were killed in a series of attacks in the town of Tayr Debba, according to Lebanon's state news agency.

item.title: Manhunt under way in South Africa after 12 killed in mass shooting in Johannesburg
item.description: Another nine people were injured at an informal settlement in Cleveland late on Tuesday.
